scenes.text: The survey ship went dark eleven years ago, all hands lost.
scenes.art_prompt: a derelict survey ship drifting in deep space, one window faintly lit, retro-sci

scenes.text: Last week its log beacon started transmitting again, clear and current.
scenes.art_prompt: a blinking transmitter beacon against black space, thin antenna, retro-sci

scenes.text: The entries were dated today. The crew names were spelled correctly.
scenes.art_prompt: a glowing console screen listing dated log entries in a dark cabin, retro-sci

scenes.text: Recovery crews found the ship empty. Cold. Sealed from the inside.
scenes.art_prompt: an empty ship corridor with sealed bulkhead doors, emergency light, retro-sci

scenes.text:
The beacon is still logging.
It has started describing the crew that is coming to find it.
scenes.art_prompt: a lone beacon pulsing in the dark with a distant approaching light, retro-sci

scenes.text: Follow Deep Space Logs for the next entry.
scenes.art_prompt: the silent ship adrift among faint stars, final wide shot, retro-sci
